clean.tx: Mene mbo urumo egen doro, igia kondep men do makmo to agöp ken do timop
clean.tl: This is too little, again give me more, add (until) it is much and let me receive it.

clean.tx: Timop to kare egen do, imban keremon o, u mene andep.
clean.tl: Let me receive it, it will be enough, the teeth will be enough to eat this pig with.

clean.tx: Wofè gol ülma‑tédaxu bando‑lu xaiman fenè fu bume‑ma‑té
clean.tl: After they have killed a pig there, they use to bring it to the tree house and slaughter it.
